name: story-point-estimation
description: Apply story-point methodology to estimate work. Defines what points mean (complexity × uncertainty × effort), establishes calibration via reference stories, applies Fibonacci progression reflecting exponential uncertainty, forecasts via velocity, and surfaces common anti-patterns (hours-to-points conversion, velocity-as-productivity, inflation across teams). Distinct from planning-poker-protocol (the HOW of a session); this is the criteria and methodology.
